findings.location: Summary, final sentence describing the long-time rotating-wave example.
findings.evidence: The summary moves from the fixed commuting case A=B=σ_z, ω=1 and its nondecaying error to failure of uniform-in-time smallness in the full class. The linked example says that this fixed case alone does not establish the class-wide conclusion, gives a commuting small-ratio bound, and then proves the stronger conclusion with a separate noncommuting family whose ratio tends to zero while the error is 2.

findings.location: Facts & Assumptions [F2] and frontmatter dependency on lem-self-adjoint-operator-generates-a-strongly-continuous-unitary-group.
findings.evidence: [F2] uses the cited published theorem for finite-matrix exponential unitarity and uniqueness, but that theorem’s Statement explicitly assumes the Axiom of Choice and the Rabi theorem does not. A local norm-convergent power-series and finite-dimensional ODE argument, or an explicit Choice hypothesis, is needed. Direct current-run consumers in batch 60 were not edited.

findings.location: Statement (b), heading and first sentence; compare the closing scope qualification.
findings.evidence: The squared transition amplitude is asserted to be the probability of finding spin down, but the item adopts no Born rule or measurement model and closes by disclaiming measurement statistics. The calculation establishes the squared amplitude only; an operational probability needs an explicit measurement postulate or model. Direct current-run consumers in batch 60 use this clause with a separate physical outcome postulate and were not edited.
